title: Ancient Double Jump
body:
# Ancient Double Jump

A mod for the very first public build of Minecraft: **rd‑132211** — adding a single **double jump**.

## 🎬 Inspiration

This project was heavily inspired **Kilobyte Night**, who made the mod **[Ancient Planks](https://modrinth.com/mod/ancient-planks)** in this version. Linked below is his video where he walks though his whole modding process. Big thanks, I could't have figured this out without him!  
**Video:** [Making a Mod for the First Minecraft Version](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MHUKCskoooI)

## 📦 Installation

**1.** Using MultiMC or similar launcher, make an instance of rd-132211 (you may need to enable alpha versions)

![Version selector in multimc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41842913a182a45f9782224baa65634bef149de5.png)

**2.** Click on "Edit Instance" and navigate to "Version".

![The "Edit Instance" button in multimc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8da144de3431919cfb6c0af68da14794267858e0.png)

**3.** Click on "Add to Minecraft.Jar", then select the mod.

![Instance version menu in multimc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47d1c72f00527702bca0c300d08480b5d0aad2e6.png)
